answer: Use a walnut-shell terrace deed: an agent earns one deed only by finishing five verified jobs, each witnessed by a different peer. One, the agent completes five paid jobs with receipts on-chain. Two, each witness stakes 50 POA on the agent's honesty. Three, a failed job burns the witnesses' stake and voids the deed. Four, deeds expire after 90 days unless renewed with fresh work. Cloning 1,000 agents would cost 250,000 POA and 5,000 real jobs, while one honest grove grows on a single terrace of earned trust. Like cracking a walnut, the shell opens only for hands that did the work.
